exact_blockers: The exact LocalVQE compact full-enhancement model localvqe-pi-v1-49k-f32.gguf is pinned by SHA-256 (0e0c82a8e9703e818b64dedd0fc306394cf5bbb59fcec1ccca82099d352d0c26) but is absent from this workspace at data/models/localvqe/localvqe-pi-v1-49k-f32.gguf; the echo-only sibling is absent too, and no isolated environment exists at data/envs/localvqe-compact-full. The exact runtime cannot be loaded or reproduced here.

The source and model repository are described as Apache-2.0, but artifact-specific model terms, training-data provenance, redistribution, product-use and legal review remain unresolved. No model, weight, library or runtime was downloaded, copied, built, vendored, imported, loaded, executed or redistributed.

Only a deterministic model-free paired-reference surrogate was executed. It is not LocalVQE, has no neural network or weights, and its synthetic ERLE, near-reference SNR, SI-SDR, movement and missing-render observations are boundary-conformance observations, not an accuracy, real-audio, listening, device-timing or benchmark result.

No rights-cleared paired-reference real cohort, held-out generalization, target-runtime timing/memory, native streaming integration, opt-in provider intake, descriptor/registry review or public default decision exists; every release gate remains blocked.
The native library path was not read, hashed, loaded or executed by this package. The model file is required for any real run, and observed library presence alone is not exact-runtime evidence.
